notes.title: Patch 1.3.2! Watch people be angry!
notes.content:
Excited to bring you another update for the game! We've got some fixes along with some feature updates!

[olist]
[*] A new guide is now available to explain how to the play the game in the guides section of our community page. 
[*] Adjusted design balance of music store to be slightly easier
[*] Two new voice actors are now in the game!
[*] Added some more visual effects to the game
[*] Added some global stats to the title screen. See how much you've done over multiple playthroughs!
[*] Adjusted the vibration levels of objects
[*] Minor Bug Fixes
[/olist]

Hope you enjoy playing the updated game!

notes.title: Release 1.3.1! Voices! Achievements! Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Are you ready to get back to giving the people what they want? Now's a perfect time! 

Updates in this release:
[olist]
[*] Added more voices for the customers thanks to contributing voice actors
[*] Added Steam Achievements. Can you get them all?
[*] Minor bug fixes, including "cat flops on ground towards player in the intro room if picked up and thrown"
[/olist]

Are we giving you want you want? Consider leaving a review for the game!

notes.title: Version 1.3 - Content and Performance
notes.content:
For the past few months, our team has been working on getting the game to run on the Meta Quest 2 without requiring a PC VR setup, and we've made a lot of changes to the game as a result! Here's a list of what's in this release:

Content Updates
> New voice actors added for the customers
> More customer visual variations
> New customer character model
> Minor visual effects additions
> Improved object movement and sound

Technical Updates
> Completely changed the lighting of the game for performance and visual reasons.
> Performance optimizations to make the game run faster on lower performance machines
> Minor bugfixes

notes.title: Version 1.2: HTC Vive now supported!
notes.content:
Hello fellow bots! You can now play the game with HTC Vive as of this patch! In addition, here's some other mandatory updates.

[olist]
[*] HTC Vive support with OpenXR
[*] You can grab more things
[*] You can now move faster than ever (if you want to, there's a control for it)
[*] You can disable the brbrbrbrbrbrbrbr (vibration) if you're not feeling it. 
[*] Control for the teleport trigger button adjusted to make it easier to use
[*] Other minor bugfixes
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release!
notes.content:
Hello fellow "Gig.Gle"rs! It's time for an upgrade!

[list]
[*] Added volume adjustment options
[*] Special objective for petting the animals
[*] Added more interactable items
[*] Fixed some animation and position issues
[*] Minor visual adjustments
[/list]
